skill.name: slack-gif-creator
skill.description: Toolkit for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack, with validators for size constraints and composable animation primitives. This skill applies when users request animated GIFs or emoji animations for Slack from descriptions like "make me a GIF for Slack of X doing Y".

content.user_title: Create Slack-Ready GIFs and Emoji Animations
content.value_statement: Slack GIFs often fail because file size, dimensions, or frame counts are wrong. This skill provides animation templates, validators, and optimization helpers for Slack-ready GIFs.
actual_capabilities: Create GIF frames with reusable animation templates such as bounce, shake, spin, fade, zoom, slide, flip, morph, and move.
Validate GIF file size and dimensions against Slack message and emoji constraints.
Save optimized GIFs with color reduction, duplicate frame removal, and emoji-focused settings.
Render emoji, text, shapes, gradients, shadows, particles, flashes, and shockwave effects.
Use easing functions, palettes, and composition helpers to build multi-phase animations.
limitations: It requires Python image dependencies such as Pillow, imageio, and numpy.
It does not upload GIFs to Slack or manage Slack workspace permissions.
Slack emoji GIFs may need several iterations to stay under the 64KB limit.
Complex scenes can become too large or visually unclear at emoji size.

use_cases.title: Create team reaction emoji
use_cases.description: Build a small animated emoji for team reactions, then validate it against Slack emoji limits.

use_cases.title: Prototype branded motion stickers
use_cases.description: Combine text, color palettes, and animation primitives to produce on-brand GIF concepts for Slack messages.

use_cases.title: Automate GIF generation workflows
use_cases.description: Use reusable Python helpers to generate, optimize, and test GIF variations for internal tools.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple emoji GIF
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small Slack emoji animation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 128x128 Slack emoji GIF of a smiling face bouncing twice. Keep it simple and validate it for the 64KB Slack emoji limit.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize an existing GIF idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request focused on Slack limits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Slack emoji GIF from this idea: [describe idea]. Use few frames, limited colors, and a validation step to keep it under 64KB.

prompt_templates.title: Build a reaction GIF sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a message-sized GIF.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 480x480 Slack message GIF where [subject] moves in, reacts, and shows a short text label. Use animation primitives and keep the result under 2MB.

prompt_templates.title: Compose a multi-phase animation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with multiple effects and validation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan and generate a Slack-ready GIF with three phases: anticipation, impact, and reaction. Combine motion, text, particles, and final validation for size and dimensions.

output_examples.input: Create a Slack emoji where a party popper bounces and releases confetti.
output_examples.output: A compact animation plan with bounce motion, brief confetti particles, 12 frames, a limited color palette, and Slack emoji validation.

output_examples.input: Make a message GIF that says GOAL after a ball lands.
output_examples.output: A 480x480 GIF concept with falling motion, impact flash, outlined text, optimized colors, and a final file size check.

output_examples.input: Turn a nervous face into a relieved face for Slack.
output_examples.output: A morph animation using crossfade and scale changes, sized for Slack, with guidance to reduce frames if the emoji limit is exceeded.

best_practices: Start with Slack dimensions and size limits before designing the animation.
Use fewer frames and colors for emoji GIFs because the 64KB limit is strict.
Validate the saved GIF after each major change to catch size problems early.
anti_patterns: Do not use detailed text or busy scenes for 128x128 emoji GIFs.
Do not add gradients, many particles, or high frame counts when targeting Slack emoji.
Do not assume a GIF is Slack-ready without checking size and dimensions.

faq.question: Can this skill create Slack custom emoji GIFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes 128x128 emoji-focused settings and validators for Slack emoji size limits.

faq.question: Can it create larger message GIFs?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports 480x480 message GIF workflows with higher frame counts and larger file limits.

faq.question: Does it upload GIFs to Slack?
faq.answer: No. It creates and validates GIF files, but Slack upload is handled outside the skill.

faq.question: Which dependencies are needed?
faq.answer: The toolkit expects Python image libraries, including Pillow, imageio, and numpy.

faq.question: How does it reduce GIF size?
faq.answer: It uses frame limits, color reduction, duplicate frame removal, and emoji-focused save options.

faq.question: Can I combine different animation effects?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is built around composable primitives that can be mixed for custom motion.
